#+title: habshe-emacs — orderless
#+author: A. Shehab (habshehabshe)

Orderless is the fuzzy matcher: space-separated patterns matched
in any order, in every menu. It is a completion style - a matcher
- not an interface; the interface is the completion buffer owned
by my-emacs-completions.

#+begin_src emacs-lisp :tangle "../lisp/my-orderless.el"
  ;;; my-orderless.el --- GENERATED from org/orderless.org — do not edit -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-
  ;;; Commentary: Orderless: fuzzy any-order matching for every menu.

  (defgroup my-orderless nil
    "Fuzzy matching for my Emacs configuration.")

  ;; Soft require: if the install pass could not run, completion
  ;; falls back to the default styles instead of breaking.
  (when (require 'orderless nil t)
    (setopt completion-styles '(orderless basic)))

  (provide 'my-orderless)
#+end_src
